description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Diana''' [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|pulls]] all nearby enemies towards her, during which they are [[File:Reveal icon.png|20px|link=Sight#Standard sight|An icon representing the keyword Standard sight]] [[:Sight#Standard sight|revealed]], then [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] them for 2 seconds.
description.text: Active: Diana pulls all nearby enemies towards her, during which they are revealed, then slows them for 2 seconds.

description2.raw: If an enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] is pulled, she calls down a beam of moonlight to strike upon the area around her after 1 second, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies, increased for each champion pulled beyond the first.
description2.text: If an enemy champion is pulled, she calls down a beam of moonlight to strike upon the area around her after 1 second, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies, increased for each champion pulled beyond the first.

notes.raw: * Enemies stay in the area for a maximum of approximately 0.5 seconds while being pulled. * [[File:Cc-immune_icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Cc-Immune]] [[:Crowd control#Immunity|Crowd control immunity]] and [[File:Unstoppable icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Displacement immune]] [[:Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|displacement immunity]] still count as being "pulled in" by the ability. * [[File:Shaco Hallucinate 2.png|20px|link=Champion_summoned_units#decoys|An icon representing the keyword Clone]] [[:Champion_summoned_units#decoys|Clones]] count as champions for increasing this ability's damage. * ''Moonfall's'' additional damage is not capped at 4 champions. * The beam of moonlight does not crash down if champions hit blocked the initial effect with [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]]. ** Enemy champions protected by ''spell shield'' do not count towards the damage increase. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time. * A lunar phase of the moon will appear above '''Diana''' while she is casting ''Moonfall'', each phase is based on the number of enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] pulled: New_Moon_Moonfall_(1_Enemy_Champion).png|{{sbc|New Moon:}} '''1''' Enemy Champion Pulled Waning_Crescent_Moonfall_(2_Enemy_Champions).png|{{sbc|Waning Crescent:}} '''2''' Enemy Champions Pulled Third_Quarter_Moonfall_(3_Enemy_Champions).png|{{sbc|Third Quarter:}} '''3''' Enemy Champions Pulled Waning_Gibbous_Moonfall_(4_Enemy_Champions).png|{{sbc|Waning Gibbous:}} '''4''' Enemy Champions Pulled Full_Moon_Moonfall_(5_Enemy_Champions).png|{{sbc|Full Moon:}} '''5''' Enemy Champions Pulled
notes.text:
Enemies stay in the area for a maximum of approximately 0.5 seconds while being pulled.
Crowd control immunity and displacement immunity still count as being "pulled in" by the ability.
Clones count as champions for increasing this ability's damage.
Moonfall's additional damage is not capped at 4 champions.
The beam of moonlight does not crash down if champions hit blocked the initial effect with spell shield.
* Enemy champions protected by spell shield do not count towards the damage increase.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
A lunar phase of the moon will appear above Diana while she is casting Moonfall, each phase is based on the number of enemy champions pulled:
New_Moon_Moonfall_(1_Enemy_Champion).png|New Moon: 1 Enemy Champion Pulled
Waning_Crescent_Moonfall_(2_Enemy_Champions).png|Waning Crescent: 2 Enemy Champions Pulled
Third_Quarter_Moonfall_(3_Enemy_Champions).png|Third Quarter: 3 Enemy Champions Pulled
Waning_Gibbous_Moonfall_(4_Enemy_Champions).png|Waning Gibbous: 4 Enemy Champions Pulled
Full_Moon_Moonfall_(5_Enemy_Champions).png|Full Moon: 5 Enemy Champions Pulled
